_source: Retell OpenAPI (https://docs.retellai.com/openapi.yaml), x-retell-spec-revision 2026-11-24-cf220c4, subset: request bodies for create/update agent, create/update Retell LLM, update phone number. Downloaded 2026-11-24.

agent_name.description: The name of the agent. Only used for your own reference.

allow_dtmf_interruption.description: If set to true, DTMF input will interrupt the agent even when interruption_sensitivity is 0. Can be overridden per conversation or subagent node. Default to false.

allow_user_dtmf.description: If set to true, DTMF input will be accepted and processed. If false, any DTMF input will be ignored. Default to true.

ambient_sound.description:
If set, will add ambient environment sound to the call to make experience more realistic. Currently supports the following options:

- `coffee-shop`: Coffee shop ambience with people chatting in background. [Listen to Ambience](https://retell-utils-public.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/coffee-shop.wav)
- `convention-hall`: Convention hall ambience, with some echo and people chatting in background. [Listen to Ambience](https://retell-utils-public.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/convention-hall.wav)
- `summer-outdoor`: Summer outdoor ambience with cicada chirping. [Listen to Ambience](https://retell-utils-public.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/summer-outdoor.wav)
- `mountain-outdoor`: Mountain outdoor ambience with birds singing. [Listen to Ambience](https://retell-utils-public.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/mountain-outdoor.wav)
- `static-noise`: Constant static noise. [Listen to Ambience](https://retell-utils-public.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/static-noise.wav)
- `call-center`: Call center work noise. [Listen to Ambience](https://retell-utils-public.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/call-center.wav)
Set to `null` to remove ambient sound from this agent.

ambient_sound_volume.description: If set, will control the volume of the ambient sound. Value ranging from [0,2]. Lower value means quieter ambient sound, while higher value means louder ambient sound. If unset, default value 1 will apply.

backchannel_frequency.description: Only applicable when enable_backchannel is true. Controls how often the agent would backchannel when a backchannel is possible. Value ranging from [0,1]. Lower value means less frequent backchannel, while higher value means more frequent backchannel. If unset, default value 0.8 will apply.

backchannel_words.description: Only applicable when enable_backchannel is true. A list of words that the agent would use as backchannel. If not set, default backchannel words will apply. Check out [backchannel default words](/agent/interaction-configuration#backchannel) for more details. Note that certain voices do not work too well with certain words, so it's recommended to experiment before adding any words.

begin_message_delay_ms.description: If set, will delay the first message by the specified amount of milliseconds, so that it gives user more time to prepare to take the call. Valid range is [0, 5000]. If not set or set to 0, agent will speak immediately. Only applicable when agent speaks first.

boosted_keywords.description: Provide a customized list of keywords to bias the transcriber model, so that these words are more likely to get transcribed. Commonly used for names, brands, street, etc. Entries may reference dynamic variables with `{{variable}}` syntax.

custom_stt_config.description: Custom STT configuration. Only used when stt_mode is set to custom.

endpointing_ms.description: Endpointing timeout in milliseconds. Minimum is 100 for Azure, 10 for Deepgram, 500 for Soniox, 100 for AssemblyAI, 100 for Muse. For AssemblyAI, this sets min_turn_silence (100-3000 ms). max_turn_silence adds half of this value, rounded to the nearest millisecond and bounded to 500-1000 ms, with a total cap of 3000 ms. Muse detects turn ends itself and ignores this value.

data_storage_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain call/chat data before automatic deletion. Must be between 1 and 730 days. If not set, data is retained forever (no automatic deletion).

data_storage_setting.description:
Granular setting to manage how Retell stores sensitive data (transcripts, recordings, logs, etc.).
This replaces the deprecated `opt_out_sensitive_data_storage` field.
- `everything`: Store all data including transcripts, recordings, and logs.
- `everything_except_pii`: Store data without PII when PII is detected.
- `basic_attributes_only`: Store only basic attributes; no transcripts/recordings/logs.
If not set, default value of "everything" will apply.

denoising_enhancement_level.description: Controls the enhancement level for background voice cancellation. Set to 0 to bypass background voice cancellation without BVC charges. Value ranging from [0,1]. Only applicable when denoising_mode is noise-and-background-speech-cancellation. Defaults to 0.8 if no value is configured. Set to null to clear the configured value. Omitting this field preserves the existing value.

denoising_mode.description: If set, determines what denoising mode to use. Use "no-denoise" to bypass all audio denoising. Default to noise-cancellation.

enable_backchannel.description: Controls whether the agent would backchannel (agent interjects the speaker with phrases like "yeah", "uh-huh" to signify interest and engagement). Backchannel when enabled tends to show up more in longer user utterances. If not set, agent will not backchannel.

enable_colloquial_model.description: Whether to rewrite generated responses with the separately billed colloquial model. This setting is independent of handbook selection and is not supported for speech-to-speech response engines. Defaults to false.

enable_dnc_detection.description: If set to true, the agent recognizes requests to stop calling or contacting the user, confirms once, and on a clear yes ends the call with disconnection reason user_requested_dnc and sets do_not_call to true on the contact for the user's phone number. If unset, default value false will apply.

enable_dynamic_responsiveness.description: If set to true, the agent will dynamically adjust how quickly it responds based on the user's speech rate and past turn-taking behavior in the call. If unset, default value false will apply.

enable_dynamic_voice_speed.description: If set to true, will enable dynamic voice speed adjustment based on the user's speech rate and conversation context. If unset, default value false will apply.

enable_expressive_mode.description: Master toggle for expressive mode. When true, the agent may add expressive voice tags to the audio it generates. Only applicable for platform voices. If unset, defaults to false.

end_call_after_silence_ms.description: If users stay silent for a period after agent speech, end the call. The minimum value allowed is 10,000 ms (10 s). By default, this is set to 600000 (10 min).

expressive_emotion_tags.description: The expressive voice tags Retell pre-teaches the model to use when enable_expressive_mode is true. Custom tags defined in the system prompt are still allowed. If empty, the agent follows general expressive guidance without a fixed tag set.

expressive_mode_prompt.description: Custom expressive voice guidance to use instead of the default Retell expressive prompt when enable_expressive_mode is true. If omitted or blank, the default expressive prompt will be used.
expressive_mode_prompt.example: Use [sigh] for thoughtful pauses and [excited] for good news.

fallback_voice_ids.description: When TTS provider for the selected voice is experiencing outages, we would use fallback voices listed here for the agent. Voice id and the fallback voice ids must be from different TTS providers. The system would go through the list in order, if the first one in the list is also having outage, it would use the next one. Set to null to remove voice fallback for the agent.

guardrail_config.description: Configuration for guardrail checks to detect and prevent prohibited topics in agent output and user input.

handbook_config.description: Enable and customize handbook prompts. Sending this field replaces the complete handbook configuration.

interruption_sensitivity.description: Controls how sensitive the agent is to user interruptions. Value ranging from [0,1]. Lower value means it will take longer / more words for user to interrupt agent, while higher value means it's easier for user to interrupt agent. If unset, default value 1 will apply. When this is set to 0, agent would never be interrupted.

ivr_option.description: If this option is set, the call will try to detect IVR in the first 3 minutes of the call. Actions defined will be applied when the IVR is detected. Set this to null to disable IVR detection.

detection_prompt.description: Optionally describe what should be treated as an IVR. Leave as null to use the default definition.

language.description: Specifies what language(s) the agent will operate in. Accepts either a single locale (e.g. `en-US`) or an array of locales for multilingual agents (e.g. `["en-US","es-ES"]`). If unset, defaults to `en-US`.

max_call_duration_ms.description: Maximum allowed length for the call, will force end the call if reached. The minimum value allowed is 60,000 ms (1 min), and maximum value allowed is 7,200,000 (2 hours). By default, this is set to 3,600,000 (1 hour).

opt_in_signed_url.description: Whether this agent opts in for signed URLs for public logs and recordings. When enabled, the generated URLs will include security signatures that restrict access and automatically expire after 24 hours.

pii_config.description: Configuration for PII scrubbing from transcripts and recordings.

post_call_analysis_data.description: Post call analysis data to extract from the call. This data will augment the pre-defined variables extracted in the call analysis. This will be available after the call ends.

post_call_analysis_model.description: The model to use for post call analysis. Default to gpt-5.6-terra.

post_session_tools.description: Integration (Agent Functions) tools run as a dependency graph during teardown, after post-call analysis. Each tool can be gated by a condition. On calls the graph is stopped after five minutes so teardown can finish. Set to null to clear.

pre_session_tools.description: Integration (Agent Functions) tools run as a dependency graph during session setup, before the agent's first message. Outputs are injected as dynamic variables. On calls the graph gets one minute unless an outbound caller will be dialed after setup, in which case it gets five minutes. Past that session initialization continues and any remaining tools finish in the background, so their outputs no longer reach the agent's prompt. Set to null to clear.

pronunciation_dictionary.description: A list of words / phrases and their pronunciation to be used to guide the audio synthesize for consistent pronunciation. Check the dashboard to see what provider supports this feature. Set to null to remove pronunciation dictionary from this agent.

alphabet.description: The phonetic alphabet to use. MiniMax speech-02-turbo supports IPA and Pinyin. MiniMax speech-2.8-turbo also supports Jyutping. Support for other alphabets depends on the selected voice provider and model.

phoneme.description: Pronunciation of the word in the format of the selected phonetic alphabet.

word.description: The string of word / phrase to be annotated with pronunciation.

reminder_max_count.description: If set, controls how many times agent would remind user when user is unresponsive. Must be a non negative integer. If unset, default value of 1 will apply (remind once). Set to 0 to disable agent from reminding.

reminder_trigger_ms.description: If set (in milliseconds), will trigger a reminder to the agent to speak if the user has been silent for the specified duration after some agent speech. Must be a positive number. If unset, default value of 10000 ms (10 s) will apply.

response_engine.description: The Response Engine to attach to the agent. It is used to generate responses for the agent. You need to create a Response Engine first before attaching it to an agent.

responsiveness.description: Controls how responsive is the agent. Value ranging from [0,1]. Lower value means less responsive agent (wait more, respond slower), while higher value means faster exchanges (respond when it can). If unset, default value 1 will apply.

ring_duration_ms.description: If set, the phone ringing will last for the specified amount of milliseconds. This applies for both outbound call ringtime, and call transfer ringtime. Default to 30000 (30 s). Valid range is [5000, 300000].

signed_url_expiration_ms.description: The expiration time for the signed url in milliseconds. Only applicable when opt_in_signed_url is true. If not set, default value of 86400000 (24 hours) will apply.

stt_mode.description: If set, determines whether speech to text should focus on latency or accuracy. Default to fast mode. When set to custom, custom_stt_config must be provided.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the agent (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to America/Los_Angeles if not set.

digit_limit.description: The maximum number of digits allowed in the user's DTMF (Dual-Tone Multi-Frequency) input per turn. Once this limit is reached, the input is considered complete and a response will be generated immediately.

termination_key.description: A single key that signals the end of DTMF input. Acceptable values include any digit (0-9), the pound/hash symbol (#), or the asterisk (*).

timeout_ms.description: The time (in milliseconds) to wait for user DTMF input before timing out. The timer resets with each digit received.

version_description.description: Optional description of the agent version. Used for your own reference and documentation.
version_description.example: Customer support agent for handling product inquiries

version_title.description: Optional title of the agent version. Used for your own reference.

vocab_specialization.description: If set, determines the vocabulary set to use for transcription. This setting only applies for English agents, for non English agent, this setting is a no-op. Default to general.

voice_id.description: Unique voice id used for the agent. Find list of available voices and their preview in Dashboard.

voice_model.description: Select the voice model used for the selected voice. Each provider has a set of available voice models. Set to null to remove voice model selection, and default ones will apply. Check out dashboard for more details of each voice model.

voice_speed.description: Controls speed of voice. Value ranging from [0.5,2]. Lower value means slower speech, while higher value means faster speech rate. If unset, default value 1 will apply.

voice_temperature.description: Controls how stable the voice is. Value ranging from [0,2]. Lower value means more stable, and higher value means more variant speech generation. Check the dashboard to see what provider supports this feature. If unset, default value 1 will apply.

voicemail_option.description: If this option is set, the call will try to detect voicemail in the first 3 minutes of the call. Actions defined (hangup, or leave a message) will be applied when the voicemail is detected. Set this to null to disable voicemail detection.

action.text: Please give us a callback tomorrow at 10am.

detection_prompt.description: Optionally describe what should be treated as voicemail. Leave as null to use the default definition.

volume.description: If set, will control the volume of the agent. Value ranging from [0,2]. Lower value means quieter agent speech, while higher value means louder agent speech. If unset, default value 1 will apply.

webhook_events.description: Which webhook events this agent should receive. If not set, defaults to call_started, call_ended, call_analyzed.

webhook_timeout_ms.description: The timeout for the webhook in milliseconds. If not set, default value of 10000 will apply.

webhook_url.description: The webhook for agent to listen to call events. See what events it would get at [webhook doc](/features/webhook). If set, will binds webhook events for this agent to the specified url, and will ignore the account level webhook for this agent. Set to `null` to remove webhook url from this agent.

agent_id.description: The id of the agent to swap to.

agent_version.description: The version of the agent to swap to. If not specified, will use the latest version.

description.description: Describes what the tool does, sometimes can also include information about when to call the tool.

execution_message_description.description: The message for the agent to speak when executing agent swap.

execution_message_type.description: Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

keep_current_language.description: If true, keep the current language when swapping agents. Defaults to false.

keep_current_voice.description: If true, keep the current voice and ambient sound settings when swapping agents. Otherwise, use the destination agent's voice and ambient sound settings. Defaults to false.

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state edges).

post_call_analysis_setting.description: Post call analysis setting for the agent swap.

use_swap_agent_max_duration.description: If true, restart the max call duration timer at the swap using the destination agent's max_call_duration_ms, capped so the whole call never exceeds 2 hours. Otherwise, the timer already running is left unchanged. Voice calls only. Defaults to false.

webhook_setting.description: Webhook setting for the agent swap, defaults to only source.

AgentVersionReference.description: Agent version reference. Supports a numeric version (for example 3) or a tag/environment name (for example "prod"). The string "latest" resolves to the most recently created version (the largest version number), and "latest_published" resolves to the most recently published version. When a tag is provided, resolution uses that exact tag assignment (including its dynamic variables). If the tag exists but is currently unassigned, it resolves to latest. When a numeric version, latest, or latest_published is provided, resolution applies dynamic variables from the preferred tag for that resolved version (most recently assigned), if any.

weight.description: The weight of the agent. When used in a list of agents, the total weights must add up to 1.

app_id.description: The connection (App) this tool runs against. Must be a connection in the organization whose provider matches this tool's provider.

app_tool_template_name.description: Name of the catalog template within the provider, as listed by list-app-templates.

description.description: Only applies to during conversation functions; ignored by the pre/post conversation. Overrides the catalog template's LLM-facing description.

enable_typing_sound.description: Only applies to during conversation functions; ignored by the pre/post conversation. If true, play a typing sound on the agent audio track while this tool is executing. Useful when the tool takes a noticeable amount of time to prevent silence on the call.

execution_message_description.description: Only applies to during conversation functions; ignored by the pre/post conversation. The message for the agent to speak when executing the tool. Only applicable when speak_during_execution is true.

execution_message_type.description: Only applies to during conversation functions; ignored by the pre/post conversation. Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within the phase's tools; referenced by depends_on. Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

parameters.description: The resolved input parameters, in order. Properties may pin a value with const (including {{variable}} references) or provide a description for LLM inference. Each property may also record selected_input_mode, the editor mode the user selected ("const_enum", "const_boolean", "const_value", "description_custom", or "description_preset"); it is stored and returned as-is, used only by the tool config UI. Omit the key when no mode is recorded; when set, const_* modes require a non-empty const, and description_* modes must omit const entirely. Each parameter's required list must match the schema returned by the corresponding step of the get-app-tool-schema loop.

provider.description: Provider of the connection. Must match the connection's provider; supported providers are listed by list-app-templates.

response_variables.description: Mapping of a dynamic-variable name to the response field (dot-path) it is populated from. Missing paths are ignored.

speak_after_execution.description: Only applies to during conversation functions; ignored by the pre/post conversation. Determines whether the agent would call LLM another time and speak when the result of the tool is obtained.

speak_during_execution.description: Only applies to during conversation functions; ignored by the pre/post conversation. If true, will speak during execution.

backup_kick_in_timeout.description: Duration in milliseconds to prefer primary model output while both models run concurrently. Must be between 300 and 60000 milliseconds, inclusive. Defaults to 1500 when omitted.

BackupModelChoice.description: Backup models are supported only for call agents. Response engines with a backup model cannot be used by chat agents.

BackupModelRef.description: Backup models are supported only for call agents. Response engines with a backup model cannot be used by chat agents.

kick_in_timeout_ms.description: How long to prefer the primary model's output while both models run, in milliseconds. Defaults to 1500.

conditional_prompt.description: Instruction for deciding whether to populate this field. Only used when required is false.

required.description: Whether this data is required. Defaults to true. If true and the data is not extracted, the call will be marked as unsuccessful. Set to false to let the field stay empty when the call has no applicable value; this is the "Allow empty value" setting in the dashboard.

type.description: Type of the variable to extract.

description.description: Describes what the tool does. This tool is only available to transfer agents (agents with isTransferAgent set to true) in agentic warm transfer mode. When invoked, it bridges the original caller to the transfer target and ends the transfer agent call.

execution_message_description.description: Describes what to say to user when bridging the transfer. Only applicable when speak_during_execution is true.

execution_message_type.description: Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state transitions). Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

speak_during_execution.description: If true, will speak during execution.

CallPresetAnalysisData.description: System preset for post-call analysis (voice agents). Use in post_call_analysis_data to override prompts or mark fields optional.

conditional_prompt.description: Instruction for deciding whether to populate this field. Only used when required is false.

description.description: Prompt or description for this preset.

name.description: Preset identifier for voice agent analysis.

required.description: If false, this field is optional in the analysis. If true or unset, the field is required.

type.description: Identifies this item as a system preset.

CallScreeningOption.description: If this option is set, the agent prompt will include call screen handling instructions for identity and call purpose questions. Set this to null to disable call screen prompt instructions.

agent_identity.description: Identity the agent should provide when a call screen asks who is calling. Dynamic variables are supported.

call_purpose.description: Purpose the agent should provide when a call screen asks why it is calling. Dynamic variables are supported.

description.description: Describes what the tool does. This tool is only available to transfer agents (agents with isTransferAgent set to true) in agentic warm transfer mode. When invoked, it cancels the transfer, returns the original caller to the main agent, and ends the transfer agent call.

execution_message_description.description: Describes what to say to user when cancelling the transfer. Only applicable when speak_during_execution is true.

execution_message_type.description: Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state transitions). Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

speak_during_execution.description: If true, will speak during execution.

backup.description: A text LLM that runs alongside the primary and takes over when the primary is slow.

type.description: Runs a text LLM with a separate voice. This is the default type.

code.description: JavaScript code to execute in the sandbox.

description.description: Describes what this tool does and when to call this tool.

enable_typing_sound.description: If true, play a typing sound on the agent audio track while this tool is executing.

execution_message_description.description: The description for the sentence agent say during execution. Only applicable when speak_during_execution is true.

execution_message_type.description: Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state edges). Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

response_variables.description: A mapping of variable names to JSON paths in the code execution result. These mapped values will be extracted and added as dynamic variables.

speak_after_execution.description: Determines whether the agent would call LLM another time and speak when the result of function is obtained.

speak_during_execution.description: Determines whether the agent would say sentence like "One moment, let me check that." when executing the tool.

timeout_ms.description: The maximum time in milliseconds the code can run before it's considered timeout. Defaults to 30,000 ms (30 s).

ContactMemoryConfig.description: Contact memory settings for phone calls and SMS chats. Creating an agent defaults enable_update to false and enable_read to true. Updates only change the supplied flags; omitted flags stay unchanged and an empty object has no effect. Set a flag to false to disable it. The configuration cannot be cleared. Existing agents without this configuration have both disabled.

enable_read.description: Automatically add saved contact memory to the agent prompt. Skippable nodes can use answers from the current conversation even when this setting is disabled. Contact dynamic variables, including contact_memory, remain available regardless of this setting.

enable_update.description: Rewrite the contact memory after each conversation. Cannot be enabled for payment agents. Requires storing conversation data. Chat agents must also have end_chat_after_silence_ms set.

args_at_root.description: If set to true, the parameters will be passed as root level JSON object instead of nested under "args".

description.description: Describes what this tool does and when to call this tool.

enable_typing_sound.description: If true, play a typing sound on the agent audio track while this tool is executing. Useful when the tool takes a noticeable amount of time to prevent silence on the call.

execution_message_description.description: The description for the sentence agent say during execution. Only applicable when speak_during_execution is true. Can write what to say or even provide examples. The default is "The message you will say to callee when calling this tool. Make sure it fits into the conversation smoothly.".

execution_message_type.description: Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

headers.description: Headers to add to the request.

max_retry.description: Maximum number of times to retry the request after a failed attempt, from 0 (no retry) to 5. Retries happen on any failure, with exponential backoff between attempts; the backoff delay is not configurable. `timeout_ms` applies per attempt rather than as a budget across all attempts, so an attempt that times out is still retried and the worst-case total duration is `timeout_ms` multiplied by (`max_retry` + 1) as well as any latency incurred by the exponential backoff + jitter between each retry. Only the final attempt's result is reported to the agent. Because retries repeat the request, only set this above 0 if your endpoint is idempotent — a retried request may be processed more than once. Defaults to 0 (no retry).

method.description: Method to use for the request, default to POST.

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state edges). Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

parameter_type.description: How the tool's `parameters` are authored and shown in the dashboard editor — "form" for the visual parameter builder, "json" for a raw JSON Schema. Both produce the same `parameters` schema; this does not change how the request body is encoded (see `args_at_root`).

query_params.description: Query parameters to append to the request URL.

response_variables.description: A mapping of variable names to JSON paths in the response body. These values will be extracted from the response and made available as dynamic variables for use.

speak_after_execution.description: Determines whether the agent would call LLM another time and speak when the result of function is obtained. Usually this needs to get turned on so user can get update for the function call.

speak_during_execution.description: Determines whether the agent would say sentence like "One moment, let me check that." when executing the function. Recommend to turn on if your function call takes over 1s (including network) to complete, so that your agent remains responsive.

timeout_ms.description: The maximum time in milliseconds the tool can run before it's considered timeout. If the tool times out, the agent would have that info. The minimum value allowed is 1000 ms (1 s), and maximum value allowed is 600,000 ms (10 min). By default, this is set to 120,000 ms (2 min).

url.description: Describes what the tool does, sometimes can also include information about when to call the tool.

DuplexModelConfig.description: Retell LLMs only. A full-duplex voice model talks to the user and delegates to a cascading backend model, which runs the LLM's prompt, tools and knowledge base. Requires backend, and the Retell LLM's voice_prompt. Tools' speak_during_execution is ignored, since the voice model covers the wait itself, and speak_after_execution is always on.

backend.description: The text LLM that answers the voice model's delegations.

backup.description: A backup for the backend model.

type.description: Runs a full-duplex voice model with a cascading backend.

custom_sip_headers.description: Custom SIP headers sent on the outgoing BYE when ending the call. Header names must start with X- or x-. Supports dynamic variables.

description.description: Describes what the tool does, sometimes can also include information about when to call the tool.

execution_message_description.description: Describes what to say to user when ending the call. Only applicable when speak_during_execution is true.

execution_message_type.description: Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state transitions). Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

speak_during_execution.description: If true, will speak during execution.

choices.description: The possible values of the variable, must be non empty array.

conditional_prompt.description: Instruction for deciding whether to populate this field. Only used when required is false.

required.description: Whether this data is required. Defaults to true. If true and the data is not extracted, the call will be marked as unsuccessful. Set to false to let the field stay empty when the call has no applicable value; this is the "Allow empty value" setting in the dashboard.

type.description: Type of the variable to extract.

right.description: Right side of the equation. The right side of the equation not required when "exists" or "not_exist" are selected.

body.description: Customer-defined fields nested in args on chat_transfer_requested events. String values support dynamic variables such as {{customer_id}}, including inside nested objects and arrays. Field names and non-string values are preserved.

url.description: Customer webhook URL for transfer requests and forwarded SMS messages.

ExecutionStatusVariable.description: Dynamic variable to store execution status as "success" or "failure". Tools skipped by conditions or dependencies leave it unchanged.

description.description: Describes what the tool does, sometimes can also include information about when to call the tool.

enable_typing_sound.description: If true, play a typing sound on the agent audio track while this tool is executing.

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state edges). Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

input_topics.description: Selected prohibited user topic categories to check. When user messages contain these topics, the agent will respond with a placeholder message instead of processing the request.

output_topics.description: Selected prohibited agent topic categories to check. When agent messages contain these topics, they will be replaced with a placeholder message.

HandbookEntryConfig.description: Configuration for an enabled handbook. Omit custom_prompt or set it to null to use the Retell-provided prompt. An empty string intentionally injects no prompt for this handbook.

filter_score.description: Similarity threshold for filtering search results

top_k.description: Max number of knowledge base chunks to retrieve

Language.description: Specifies what language (and dialect) the agent will operate in. For instance, selecting `en-GB` optimizes speech recognition for British English and indexes knowledge bases with English. If unset, will use default value `en-US`.

oneOf.description: Legacy handbook toggle. True enables the Retell-provided prompt; false disables it.

headers.description: Headers to add to the MCP connection request.

query_params.description: Query parameters to append to the  MCP connection request URL.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for an MCP tool call to return (in milliseconds). Values below 60,000 are treated as 60,000, and values above 600,000 are treated as 600,000. Default to 60,000 ms (1 minute).

url.description: The URL of the MCP server.

enable_typing_sound.description: If true, play a typing sound on the agent audio track while this MCP tool is executing.

execution_message_description.description: The description for the sentence agent say during execution. Only applicable when speak_during_execution is true. Can write what to say or even provide examples. The default is "The message you will say to callee when calling this tool. Make sure it fits into the conversation smoothly.".

execution_message_type.description: Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

input_schema.description: The input schema of the MCP tool.

response_variables.description: Response variables to add to dynamic variables, key is the variable name, value is the path to the variable in the response

speak_after_execution.description: Determines whether the agent would call LLM another time and speak when the result of function is obtained. Usually this needs to get turned on so user can get update for the function call.

speak_during_execution.description: Determines whether the agent would say sentence like "One moment, let me check that." when executing the function. Recommend to turn on if your function call takes over 1s (including network) to complete, so that your agent remains responsive.

high_priority.description: Whether to use high priority pool with more dedicated resource, default false

ultrafast.description: Whether to use the ultrafast tier for much faster response generation, default false. Only supported by gpt-6.1-sol on voice agents; ignored otherwise. Takes precedence over high_priority.

ModelConfig.description: Model settings for the response engine. type decides which models primary and backup accept. On update, each top-level key replaces the current one and omitted keys are kept; set backup to null to remove it. Changing type requires primary and clears backup, while temperature carries over. In agent_override, type is required whenever primary is set; setting backup to null disables it for that call only.

ModelTemperature.description: Randomness of the response, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0; a lower value is recommended for tool calling.

conditional_prompt.description: Instruction for deciding whether to populate this field. Only used when required is false.

description.example: How many the customer intend to order.

required.description: Whether this data is required. Defaults to true. If true and the data is not extracted, the call will be marked as unsuccessful. Set to false to let the field stay empty when the call has no applicable value; this is the "Allow empty value" setting in the dashboard.

type.description: Type of the variable to extract.

OutputSelection.description: Which fields of a successful JSON tool response the agent and the transcript see. Omit to keep all fields. Does not affect response_variables, which are always extracted from the raw response. Non-JSON responses and failed tool results are not filtered. Response size limits still apply.

fields.description: Not used at runtime; stored and returned as-is for the UI.

The only response fields the agent and the transcript see, as dot-paths into the response (for app tools, the response schema returned by get-app-tool-schema). Everything else is dropped. Selecting a parent keeps its whole subtree. A plain segment traverses arrays element-wise (deals.properties.amount keeps that field on every deal), while key[n] selects one element (deals[0].id keeps only the first deal's id); paths that match nothing contribute nothing.

categories.description: List of PII categories to scrub from transcripts and recordings. PII redaction is only active when this list is non-empty; an empty array means no PII scrubbing is performed.

mode.description: The processing mode for PII scrubbing. Currently only post-call is supported.

PostCallAnalysisData.description: Post-call analysis item (custom data or voice preset). Use for voice agent post_call_analysis_data; validates only call presets (call_summary, call_successful, user_sentiment).

condition.description: Optional gate; the step only runs when the condition holds. Defaults to always running.

depends_on.description: Names of tools that must run before this one.

PostSessionTool.description: A post-session tool with an optional condition. Parameter inference uses the agent prompt, dynamic variables, and conversation. Same tools as PreSessionTool plus send_sms, which is only supported on phone calls — the session is over, so the speak settings are ignored and an inferred sms_content is written by the LLM from the transcript at teardown.

depends_on.description: Names of tools that must run before this one.

PreSessionTool.description: A pre-session tool (app / custom / code, discriminated by type) plus its dependency edges. The tool's name is the depends_on handle and must be unique across the agent's session tools. Parameters may set a constant value or a description for the LLM to infer the value. Pre-session inference uses the agent prompt and dynamic variables.

delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds before pressing the digit, because a lot of IVR systems speak very slowly, and a delay can make sure the agent hears the full menu. Default to 1000 ms (1s). Valid range is 0 to 5000 ms (inclusive).

description.description: Describes what the tool does, sometimes can also include information about when to call the tool.

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state transitions). Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

conversation_flow_id.description: ID of the Conversation Flow Response Engine.

version.description: Version of the Conversation Flow Response Engine.

llm_websocket_url.description: LLM websocket url of the custom LLM.

llm_id.description: id of the Retell LLM Response Engine.

version.description: Version of the Retell LLM Response Engine.

RetellLlmOverride.description: Override properties for Retell LLM configuration in agent override requests.

backup_model.description: Replace backup model configuration for this call only. Omit to inherit the saved configuration, or set null to disable backup. An omitted backup_kick_in_timeout in a supplied configuration defaults to 1500 milliseconds.

begin_after_user_silence_ms.description: If set, the AI will begin the conversation after waiting for the user for the duration (in milliseconds) specified by this attribute. This only applies if the agent is configured to wait for the user to speak first. If not set, the agent will wait indefinitely for the user to speak.

begin_message.description: First utterance said by the agent in the call. If not set, LLM will dynamically generate a message. If set to "", agent will wait for user to speak first.
begin_message.example: Hey I am a virtual assistant calling from Retell Hospital.

kb_config.description: Knowledge base configuration for RAG retrieval.

knowledge_base_ids.description: A list of knowledge base ids to use for this resource.

model.description: Deprecated, use model_config.primary. Ignored when model_config is set.

model_high_priority.description: Deprecated, use model_config.primary.tier fast. Ignored when model_config is set.

model_temperature.description: Deprecated, use model_config.temperature. Ignored when model_config is set.

model_ultrafast.description: Deprecated, use model_config.primary.tier ultrafast. Ignored when model_config is set.

s2s_model.description: Deprecated, use model_config with type s2s. Ignored when model_config is set.

start_speaker.description: The speaker who starts the conversation. Required. Must be either 'user' or 'agent'.

default_dynamic_variables.description: Default dynamic variables represented as key-value pairs of strings. These are injected into your Retell LLM prompt and tool description when specific values are not provided in a request. Only applicable for Retell LLM.

general_prompt.description:
General prompt appended to system prompt no matter what state the agent is in.

- System prompt (with state) = general prompt + state prompt.
- System prompt (no state) = general prompt.

general_tools.description:
A list of tools the model may call (to get external knowledge, call API, etc). You can select from some common predefined tools like end call, transfer call, etc; or you can create your own custom tool for the LLM to use.

- Tools of LLM (with state) = general tools + state tools + state transitions
- Tools of LLM (no state) = general tools

is_transfer_llm.description: Whether this Retell LLM is used for warm transfer. Can only be set at creation, and is ignored on update.

mcps.description: A list of MCPs to use for this LLM.

starting_state.description: Name of the starting state. Required if states is not empty.

states.description: States of the LLM. This is to help reduce prompt length and tool choices when the call can be broken into distinct states. With shorter prompts and less tools, the LLM can better focus and follow the rules, minimizing hallucination. If this field is not set, the agent would only have general prompt and general tools (essentially one state).

example.name: information_collection
example.state_prompt: You will follow the steps below to collect information...

example.name: appointment_booking
example.state_prompt: You will follow the steps below to book an appointment...

voice_prompt.description: Prompt for the voice model when model_config.type is duplex, at most 15,000 tokens. Required for duplex, where general_prompt is the backend's prompt. Kept when you switch models.
voice_prompt.example: You are a friendly voice assistant for ...

description.description: Describes what the tool does, sometimes can also include information about when to call the tool.

execution_message_description.description: Describes what to say before sending the SMS. Only applicable when speak_during_execution is true.

execution_message_type.description: Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state edges). Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

sms_destination.description: SMS destination number configuration. If omitted, the message is sent to the customer number on the call.

sms_sender.description: SMS sender number configuration. If omitted, the message is sent from the agent's phone number.

speak_after_execution.description: Whether the agent should speak after the SMS tool finishes execution.

speak_during_execution.description: If true, the agent will speak a short line before sending the SMS. If omitted, defaults to true (same as end_call / transfer_call tools).

ServiceTier.description: Capacity tier for a model. standard is always available. fast draws from dedicated capacity for lower, steadier latency, and ultrafast is faster still on voice agents; faster tiers cost more. Each model offers its own set of tiers, and a tier the model does not offer is rejected.

SipCodecList.description: SIP codec preferences for custom phone numbers only, used for inbound and outbound gateway calls. Retell-managed Twilio and Telnyx phone numbers do not support this setting. An empty list uses the gateway's default codecs. Codec names are extensible and are not limited to the examples.

prompt.description: The prompt to be used to help infer the SMS content. The model will take the global prompt, the call transcript, and this prompt together to deduce the right message to send. Can contain dynamic variables.

text.description: The static message to be sent in the SMS. Can contain dynamic variables.

template.description: The template to use for the SMS content. "info_collection" sends a predefined message requesting information from the user.

ignore_e164_validation.description: If true, skip E.164 validation for this phone number (same semantics as transfer_call ignore_e164_validation).

phone_number.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format.

edges.description: Edges of the state define how and what state can be reached from this state.

name.description: Name of the state, must be unique for each state. Must be consisted of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64 (no space allowed).

state_prompt.description:
Prompt of the state, will be appended to the system prompt of LLM.

- System prompt = general prompt + state prompt.
state_prompt.example:
## Task
You will follow the steps below...

tools.description:
A list of tools specific to this state the model may call (to get external knowledge, call API, etc). You can select from some common predefined tools like end call, transfer call, etc; or you can create your own custom tool for the LLM to use.

- Tools of LLM = general tools + state tools + state transitions

description.description: Describes what's the transition and at what time / criteria should this transition happen.

destination_state_name.description: The destination state name when going through transition of state via this edge. State transition internally is implemented as a tool call of LLM, and a tool call with name "transition_to_{destination_state_name}" will get created. Feel free to reference it inside the prompt.

parameters.description: Describes what parameters you want to extract out when the transition changes. The parameters extracted here can be referenced in prompts & function descriptions of later states via dynamic variables. The parameters the functions accepts, described as a JSON Schema object. See [JSON Schema reference](https://json-schema.org/understanding-json-schema/) for documentation about the format.

conditional_prompt.description: Instruction for deciding whether to populate this field. Only used when required is false.

examples.description: Examples of the variable value to teach model the style and syntax.

required.description: Whether this data is required. Defaults to true. If true and the data is not extracted, the call will be marked as unsuccessful. Set to false to let the field stay empty when the call has no applicable value; this is the "Allow empty value" setting in the dashboard.

type.description: Type of the variable to extract.

ToolParameter.description: The parameters the functions accepts, described as a JSON Schema object. See [JSON Schema reference](https://json-schema.org/understanding-json-schema/) for documentation about the format. Omitting parameters defines a function with an empty parameter list.

additionalProperties.description: On an integration function's response schema, false means the output fields are fixed to properties and no others can be added.

properties.description: The value of properties is an object, where each key is the name of a property and each value is a schema used to validate that property.

required.description: List of names of required property when generating this parameter. LLM will do its best to generate the required properties in its function arguments. Property must exist in properties.

type.description: Type must be "object" for a JSON Schema object.

custom_sip_headers.description: Custom SIP headers to be added to the call.

description.description: Describes what the tool does, sometimes can also include information about when to call the tool.

execution_message_description.description: Describes what to say to user when transferring the call. Only applicable when speak_during_execution is true.

execution_message_type.description: Type of execution message. "prompt" means the agent will use execution_message_description as a prompt to generate the message. "static_text" means the agent will speak the execution_message_description directly. Defaults to "prompt".

ignore_e164_validation.description: If true, the e.164 validation will be ignored for the from_number. This can be useful when you want to dial to internal pseudo numbers. This only applies when you are using custom telephony and does not apply when you are using Retell Telephony. If omitted, the default value is false.

name.description: Name of the tool. Must be unique within all tools available to LLM at any given time (general tools + state tools + state edges).

speak_during_execution.description: If true, will speak during execution.

prompt.description: The prompt to be used to help infer the transfer destination. The model will take the global prompt, the call transcript, and this prompt together to deduce the right number to transfer to. Can contain dynamic variables.

extension.description: Extension digits to dial after the main number connects. Sent via DTMF. Allow digits, '*', '#', or a dynamic variable like {{extension}}.

number.description: The number to transfer to in E.164 format or a dynamic variable like {{transfer_number}}.

agentic_transfer_config.description: Configuration for agentic warm transfer. Required for agentic warm transfer.

action_on_timeout.description: The action to take when the transfer agent times out without making a decision. Defaults to cancel_transfer.

transfer_agent.description: The agent that will mediate the transfer decision.

agent_id.description: The agent ID of the transfer agent. This agent must have isTransferAgent set to true and should use bridge_transfer and cancel_transfer tools (for Retell LLM) or BridgeTransferNode and CancelTransferNode (for Conversation Flow).

agent_version.description: The version of the transfer agent to use.

transfer_timeout_ms.description: The maximum time to wait for the transfer agent to make a decision, in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000 (30 seconds).

custom_on_hold_music_asset_id.description: Asset ID of the uploaded hold music to play. Required when `on_hold_music` is `custom`. Must reference an audio asset owned by the organization (see create-asset).

enable_bridge_audio_cue.description: Whether to play an audio cue when bridging the call. Defaults to true.

on_hold_music.description: The music to play while the caller is being transferred. Use `custom` together with `custom_on_hold_music_asset_id` to play an uploaded audio asset.

public_handoff_option.description: If set, when transfer is successful, will say the handoff message to both the transferee and the agent receiving the transfer. Can leave either a static message or a dynamic one based on prompt. Set to null to disable warm handoff.

show_transferee_as_caller.description: If set to true, will show transferee (the user, not the AI agent) as caller when transferring, requires the telephony side to support caller id override. Retell Twilio numbers support this option.

transfer_ring_duration_ms.description: Override the ring duration for this specific transfer, in milliseconds. If not set, falls back to the agent-level `ring_duration_ms`.

cold_transfer_mode.description: The mode of the cold transfer. If set to `sip_refer`, will use SIP REFER to transfer the call. If set to `sip_invite`, will use SIP INVITE to transfer the call.

custom_on_hold_music_asset_id.description: Asset ID of the uploaded hold music to play. Required when `on_hold_music` is `custom`. Must reference an audio asset owned by the organization (see create-asset).

on_hold_music.description: The music to play while the caller is being transferred. If omitted, preserves the existing transfer audio behavior. Use `custom` together with `custom_on_hold_music_asset_id` to play an uploaded audio asset.

show_transferee_as_caller.description: If set to true, will show transferee (the user, not the AI agent) as caller when transferring. Requires the telephony side to support caller id override. Retell Twilio numbers support this option. This parameter takes effect only when `cold_transfer_mode` is set to `sip_invite`. When using `sip_refer`, this option is not available. Retell Twilio numbers always use user's number as the caller id when using `sip refer` cold transfer mode.

transfer_ring_duration_ms.description: Override the ring duration for this specific transfer, in milliseconds. If not set, falls back to the agent-level `ring_duration_ms`.

agent_detection_timeout_ms.description: The time to wait before considering transfer fails.

custom_on_hold_music_asset_id.description: Asset ID of the uploaded hold music to play. Required when `on_hold_music` is `custom`. Must reference an audio asset owned by the organization (see create-asset).

enable_bridge_audio_cue.description: Whether to play an audio cue when bridging the call. Defaults to true.

ivr_option.description: IVR navigation option to run when doing human detection. This prompt will guide the AI on how to navigate the IVR system.

on_hold_music.description: The music to play while the caller is being transferred. Use `custom` together with `custom_on_hold_music_asset_id` to play an uploaded audio asset.

opt_out_human_detection.description: If set to true, will not perform human detection for the transfer. Default to false.

private_handoff_option.description: If set, when transfer is connected, will say the handoff message only to the agent receiving the transfer. Can leave either a static message or a dynamic one based on prompt. Set to null to disable warm handoff.

public_handoff_option.description: If set, when transfer is successful, will say the handoff message to both the transferee and the agent receiving the transfer. Can leave either a static message or a dynamic one based on prompt. Set to null to disable warm handoff.

show_transferee_as_caller.description: If set to true, will show transferee (the user, not the AI agent) as caller when transferring, requires the telephony side to support caller id override. Retell Twilio numbers support this option.

transfer_ring_duration_ms.description: Override the ring duration for this specific transfer, in milliseconds. If not set, falls back to the agent-level `ring_duration_ms`.

VoiceHandbookConfig.description: Independently selectable handbook prompts for voice agents. Phase 1 accepts legacy booleans in requests, but responses always return the object form.

ai_disclosure.description: When asked, acknowledge being a virtual assistant.

conversational_personality.description: Legacy name for conversational. Cannot be sent together with conversational. For compatibility, true also enables enable_colloquial_model when that field is omitted.

default_personality.description: Legacy name for customer_support. Cannot be sent together with customer_support.

echo_verification.description: Repeat back and confirm important details (voice only).

nato_phonetic_alphabet.description: Spell using NATO phonetic alphabet style (voice only).

natural_filler_words.description: Sprinkle natural speech fillers like "um", "you know" for a more human, conversational tone.

scope_boundaries.description: Stay within prompt/context scope, don't invent details.

smart_matching.description: Treat near-match similar words as same entity to reduce impact of transcription error (voice only).

speech_normalization.description: Convert numbers/dates/currency to spoken forms (voice only).

text.description: The prompt used to generate the text to be spoken when the call is detected to be in voicemail.
The text to be spoken when the call is detected to be in voicemail.
text.example: Please give us a callback tomorrow at 10am.

prompt.description: The prompt to be used for warm handoff. Can contain dynamic variables.
prompt.example: Summarize the call in one sentence for the warn handoff.

message.description: The static message to be used for warm handoff. Can contain dynamic variables.
message.example: You can take it from here.

is_transfer_agent.description: Whether to create the agent as a transfer agent for agentic warm transfer. You can only set this field when creating the agent. The response engine must also be configured for transfer use with is_transfer_llm or is_transfer_cf. Custom LLM agents cannot be transfer agents.

allowed_inbound_country_list.description: List of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes from which inbound calls are allowed. If not set or empty, calls from all countries are allowed.

allowed_outbound_country_list.description: List of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to which outbound calls are allowed. If not set or empty, calls to all countries are allowed.

auth_password.description: The password used for authentication for the SIP trunk to update for the phone number.

auth_username.description: The username used for authentication for the SIP trunk to update for the phone number.

fallback_number.description: When inbound call concurrency is reached and a slot does not free up after extended ringing, the call will fall back to this number. Can be either a Retell phone number or an external number. Set to null to remove. Cannot be the same as this phone number, and cannot be a number that already has its own fallback configured (prevents nested forwarding).

inbound_agents.description: Inbound agents to bind to the number with weights. If set and non-empty, one agent will be picked randomly for each inbound call, with probability proportional to the weight. Total weights must add up to 1.

inbound_fallback_enabled.description: Whether to enable inbound fallback for this phone number. When enabled, inbound calls are transferred to the fallback number. Requires fallback_number to be set.

inbound_sms_agents.description: Inbound SMS agents to bind to the number with weights. If set and non-empty, one agent will be picked randomly for each inbound SMS, with probability proportional to the weight. Total weights must add up to 1.

inbound_sms_webhook_url.description: If set, Retell will send a webhook for inbound SMS, where you can override the agent ID, set dynamic variables, reject the SMS, and configure other fields specific to that chat. Includes chat_inbound.chat_id for deduplication across HTTP retries. Early setup failures may not create a chat history record.

inbound_webhook_url.description: If set, Retell will send a webhook for inbound calls, where you can override the agent ID, set dynamic variables, reject the call, and configure other fields specific to that call. Includes call_inbound.call_id for deduplication across HTTP retries. Early setup failures may not create a call history record.

nickname.description: Nickname of the number. This is for your reference only.

outbound_agents.description: Outbound agents to bind to the number with weights. If set and non-empty, one agent will be picked randomly for each outbound call, with probability proportional to the weight. Total weights must add up to 1.

outbound_sms_agents.description: Outbound SMS agents to bind to the number with weights. If set and non-empty, one agent will be picked randomly for each outbound SMS, with probability proportional to the weight. Total weights must add up to 1.

termination_uri.description: The termination uri to update for the phone number. This is used for outbound calls.

transport.description: Outbound transport protocol to update for the phone number. Valid values are "TLS", "TCP" and "UDP". Default is "TCP".
